1. Left: drum-top sifter on the drum under the blender (section, looking north). Right: hammer mill station (looking east). True scale 1:10.
2. The sifter rides on the drum: roll the drum in on its dolly, set the sifter on the rim, clamp the sock. No sieve frame, no chute.
3. Mill model and flanges VERIFY on the chosen mill; run a grind trial with our peppercorns before ordering.
4. Ground spice goes in lined pails to bin B06 (coarse black pepper); the pail lot is the new MES lot.
5. Bond sieve, mill and drums to ground; mill motor TEFC; electrical class per the DHA.
